question: q1-weber found no single internal time: gemma3's count estimate rose with its long words, gemma4's fell, qwen3.8's barely moved. Its long words were longer in characters, in tokens and rarer at once. What does each model's estimate follow: the characters of the list, or its tokens (with rarity, which BPE ties to them)?
seeds: seed = int(sha256('<registration id>:<beacon randomness>:<model>:<condition>:<n>:<k>').hexdigest()[:12], 16): the list is random.Random(seed) choices from the condition's vocabulary; the model's sampling seed is seed mod 2^31.
beacon: drand quicknet (chain 52db9ba70e0cc0f6eaf7803dd07447a1f5477735fd3f661792ba94600c84e971): the first round dated at or after the earliest GitHub-witnessed push (GET repos/s0fractal/time-lab/activity) that holds the commit adding q8-what-counts/registration.lock.json.

design.order: models in the order above, one at a time; within a model short, one, many; n ascending, k ascending

conditions.name: short
conditions.about: q1-weber's short words: one token in each model, 5.5 characters on average

conditions.name: one
conditions.about: long common words that are one token in each model (calibration/candidates.json), 13.4 characters

conditions.name: many
conditions.about: rare words of the same length that are three to seven tokens in each model (calibration/candidates-many.json), 13.3 characters

hypotheses.statement: gemma3's estimate grows with the characters of the list: at equal tokens, words 2.4 times longer in characters raise it with an elasticity above 0.15 (calibration: 0.37).
hypotheses.rule: Per model and condition, tau = tokens per word and chi = characters per word are the slopes over n of the prompt's tokens (ollama's prompt_eval_count) and of the list's characters. Over n in the grid, with medians of the parsed integer answers: iota_chars = mean_n log(median one / median short) / log(chi_one / chi_short); iota_tokens = mean_n log(median many / median one) / log(tau_many / tau_one); chars-minus-tokens = their difference. A 95% interval (inverted-cdf quantiles) over 2000 resamples of the lists of every (condition, n) cell, the same resamples for all three, seeded from the registration id and the model. Inconclusive by rule: fewer than 95% of a condition's answers hold an integer; the axis held equal differs by more than 10% or the axis varied changes by less than 1.5 times; a median estimate is not positive. Supported if the interval of gemma3:27b's iota_chars lies above 0.15; contradicted if it lies wholly below; else inconclusive.

hypotheses.statement: Characters move gemma3's estimate more than its tokens do: q1-weber's 'own duration' (iota +0.71) is mostly the length of the text (calibration: iota_chars 0.37, iota_tokens 0.17).
